# Dear ImGui

Vendored Dear ImGui v1.92.4-docking from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/tree/v1.92.4-docking
(commit `e7d2d636affeeac1fc7175fb13472ca02d1bc0d1`). The original MIT license is
in `LICENSE.txt`. These are unmodified upstream core files and the Win32/DX11
backends needed by AGP; examples and unused backends are omitted. This release
includes docking and multi-viewports so debug windows can move to other monitors.

The files are stored directly in this directory so a Git checkout and a Perforce
sync use the same version without a submodule, package manager, or download step.
When updating, copy the core `.cpp` and `.h` files, `LICENSE.txt`, and the
`imgui_impl_win32`/`imgui_impl_dx11` pairs from one upstream release, then update
the version and commit above. Keep the set of compiled files in
`Source/Engine/GraphicsEngine/premake5.lua` in sync.
